content: दूषक {%a.%} (-षिका|{%f.%}) [दुष्-णिच्-ण्वुल्] .²1 Corrupting, polluting, vitiating, defiling, spoiling; कौ युवां मुनिदूषकौ <ls>Rām. 3. 2. 12</ls>. .²2 Violating, dishonouring, seducing; राज्ञः शासनदूषकैः <ls>Mk. 9. 41</ls>. .²3 Offending, trespassing, guilty. .²4 Disfiguring. .²5 Sinful, wicked (as an action). .²6 Irreligious; यः पुरुषाणां हि दूषकः <ls>Rām. 4. 38. 26</ls>. .{@-कः@} .²1 A seducer, a corrupter. .²2 Any infamous or wicked person.
